links.outcome: Whether clinician verification against clinical context caught a false-positive AI pneumothorax alert
links.effect: AI flagged right apical pneumothorax after left-sided pacemaker; team judged it discordant, CT excluded pneumothorax; no unnecessary intervention, uneventful recovery.
links.quote: The alert was immediately considered clinically discordant by the treating team, given the left-sided venous access, normal oxygen saturation, hemodynamic stability, and absence of respiratory symptoms.

links.outcome: Whether clinician retained final decision authority over AI-flagged finding
links.effect: Clinicians overrode false-positive AI alert using clinical reasoning and confirmatory CT; patient required no additional intervention.
links.quote: This case also emphasizes that AI should be regarded as a clinical decision-support tool rather than an autonomous diagnostic system and highlights the continuing importance of physician oversight in ensuring patient safety during AI-assisted post-procedural imaging interpretation.

unlisted_practices: Integrating procedural information and pre-test probability with AI imaging findings
Confirmatory CT when clinicoradiological discordance is present

screen.reason: Case report describing a real-world clinical deployment/use of an AI-assisted chest radiograph system that produced a false-positive pneumothorax alert, mitigated by clinician oversight.
